attributes.board_name: Maine Board of Counseling Professionals Licensure

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs by accredited institutions, professional organizations, human services organizations or individuals: graduate courses, institutes, workshops, conferences, in-service, formal home study and online programs; up to 15 h peer consultation; max 5 h informal home study/prerecorded; writing max 20 h; teaching/presenting max 5 h; intern supervision max 5 h
rules.audit_note: Licensee attests at renewal; each activity must be documented by a signed certificate, transcript or other written proof.

topics.who: Subjects in the board's Code of Ethics (Chapter 8-A)

rules.notes: Same board and CE chapter as counselors: 55 hours per license biennium.
